releaseNotes: - Canvas Type "Front Bookstrip" is now "Boxtrip". Old orders show and print as Boxtrip; saved orders are not changed.
- Customer list: highest customer number at the top, with "Total Customers: N" shown above the list.
- Unfinished orders are saved automatically and can be resumed after switching customer or closing the app.
- Kurta has three cuts (Kurta, Short Kurta, Apple Cut Kurta); shirt slips say "Full Shirt" on a mixed sleeve line.
- Safety: customers and bills that have orders or payments can no longer be deleted; saving an order can no longer undo a later payment.
